flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminui components/datagrid/column/index.tsx (TableColumn), pages/NoticeSearch/list/{NoticeSearchAllList,NoticeSearchOutstandingList,NoticeValidList}, pages/PS/{list/PSList,form/PSForm,page/PSView}. ocmsadminapi crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice (validoffencenoticelist). Other repos not involved
note: Status 'Fully paid'. The All Notices search grid and the upload result grid use the same columns (TableColumn) and show vehicle number, processing stage, suspension type and reason; the Outstanding mode grid shows vehicle number and processing stage but no suspension type/reason. The suspension details shown are limited to type, reason (epr_reason_of_suspension) and, on the PS page, due date of revival; suspension date, source, remarks and the authorising officer are not shown in any grid in this flow (they are on the notice detail page, outside this story). Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-187 (sorting of the Payment Status column used the suspensionType field, Pending UAT Verification): in the main code the payment_status column already uses crsReasonOfSuspension (column/index.tsx:272), deployment cannot be verified from repo; it does not change the verdict because it concerns sorting, not the column content.
recommendation: Claim partially (see Sebagian/Beda dari flow steps)

steps.step: Search results show the notice number, vehicle number and processing stage
steps.detail: NoticeSearchAllList renders the columns notice_no (+ summon/NTAC), notice_type, date, place, rule_code, processing_stage, vehicle_no, vehicle_type from TableColumn (NoticeSearchAllList.tsx:137-172; column/index.tsx:200-232). Outstanding mode shows processing stage, notice no, rule code, vehicle no, place, date, amount, current offender and court date (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:160-182).

steps.step: Upload results show the notices with the same key details
steps.detail: UploadResult uses NoticeValidList, which has the same columns: notice_no, notice_type, processing_stage, vehicle_no, vehicle_type, suspension_type, suspension_reason, payment_status, amount_payable, court_date, current_offender (NoticeValidList.tsx:31-69).

steps.step: Existing suspension details (if any) are shown
steps.detail: The Suspension Type column (suspensionType, 'NA' shown as '-') and Reason for Suspension (eprReasonOfSuspension) are in the search and upload grids (column/index.tsx:242-258); the PS page adds Due Date of Revival (column/index.tsx:262-268; PSList.tsx:136-140). The Outstanding mode grid has no suspension type/reason column at all (NoticeSearchOutstandingList.tsx:160-182). Suspension date, source, remarks and the authorising officer are not shown in this flow, so 'suspension details' are only partly covered.

steps.step: The selected notices are shown as a summary before permanent suspension
steps.detail: After notices are selected, PSForm shows a PSList titled 'Selected Notices (n)' on the details tab and the Summary tab (PSForm.tsx:346-393) with notice, vehicle, current/next stage, suspension type/reason, due date of revival, payment status and amount columns (PSList.tsx:103-152). Notices already PS are highlighted with the banner 'Notice(s) highlighted have existing Permanent Suspension (PS)' (PSList.tsx:66-90).
